name: Joshua Groban
title: Associate Justice, Supreme Court of California
years_of_service: Associate Justice since January 3, 2019 (appointed by Gov. Jerry Brown; confirmed December 21, 2018). (Wikipedia)
background: Groban was born August 15, 1973, and raised in Del Mar, where he graduated from Torrey Pines High School. He earned a B.A. from Stanford (1995) and a J.D. from Harvard Law School (1998). (Wikipedia)

He clerked for U.S. District Judge William C. Conner in New York (1998 to 1999) and practiced at Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison (1999 to 2005) and Munger, Tolles & Olson (2005 to 2010), focusing on antitrust and intellectual-property litigation. He was counsel to Jerry Brown's 2010 campaign and then a senior adviser in the Brown administration, where he oversaw the governor's judicial appointments. He teaches State Appellate Practice at UCLA School of Law. (Wikipedia; CalMatters)

Brown appointed him on November 14, 2018, to replace retiring Justice Kathryn Werdegar. Voters retained him in 2022 with 68.4% for the remainder of her term, and he is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for a full 12-year term. (Wikipedia; GrowSF)
